text: Committed 6280609 on worktree-agent-a4cac5af73782c350. Finding: repo bundles no font (only LiberationSans inside the PDFBox test dependency). Delivered opt-in SvgFontFace/SvgFonts + SvgRenderer.render(..., fonts) overloads embedding caller-supplied faces as @font-face data URIs, only for used families; fsType restricted-embedding refused for TTF/OTF; no subsetting (ADR 0009).
